senses.gloss: m. pl. (v. preced., cmp. גֵּאִים) haughtiness, tyranny.
units: B. Kam. 114ᵃ דדייני בג׳ (Rashi בגֵיוְתָא, Ms. H. בגֵּיוְתָה, Ms. R. בגֵוְתֵי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 2 for Var. lect.) whom they (the gentile judges) convict tyrannically (not listening to arguments), opp. to Jewish judges who go by argument, points of law &c. [Rashi a. v. מגיזתא, B. Mets. 30ᵇ, quotes our w. גִּיזְתַּיָּא; Ms. F. has גִּיזְתֵּי, fr. גזז with, anomalous pl. arbitrary decisions, v. מְגִיזְתָּא.]
